basis: Unmounted native positions in separate actor roots; initial numbers are hypotheses for a bounded mounted calibration, not measured mounted fit.
units: native Unity world units; zero Euler and unit aligned roots are assumed for this calculation
coordinateAssumption: Initial rider and Horse root axes align at the Chest anchor; mounted animation must test and correct this assumption.
translationDerivation: A selected -0.28 Y total, decomposed as mountRootOffset -0.16 and animatedSeatCorrection -0.12, places the rider thigh origins for an initial stirrup reach check. The decomposition and alignment are calibration choices, not observations.
footTargetEquation: targetFromThigh = horseStirrupFromChest - riderThighFromRoot - (0,-0.28,0); separate observed roots are provisionally treated as aligned
